items.title: California fines Afterpay $2.7M
items.why: BNPL ability-to-repay scrutiny is rising; build underwriting and affordability checks into diligence on any embedded BNPL partner.
items.summary_ai: California fined Afterpay $2.7M for failing to assess customers' ability to repay its BNPL loans.
items.take: BNPL ability-to-repay scrutiny is rising; build underwriting and affordability checks into diligence on any embedded BNPL partner.
